name: The Masters of the Renaissance
description: From Giotto's first solid figures to Michelangelo's ceiling: the painters, sculptors and builders who remade European art between the 1300s and the 1500s.

checkpoints.name: Before the rebirth
checkpoints.note: In Tuscany, Giotto paints people with weight and feeling, and a century later Florence is ready to look back at Rome and Greece for ideas.

checkpoints.name: Florence leads
checkpoints.note: Brunelleschi raises the great dome, Donatello casts a bronze nude and Jan van Eyck perfects oil paint in the north. Bankers such as the Medici pay for it all.

checkpoints.name: The high Renaissance
checkpoints.note: Leonardo, Michelangelo and Raphael work in Florence and Rome for popes and princes, and produce the Mona Lisa, the David and the Sistine ceiling.

checkpoints.name: Venice and beyond
checkpoints.note: Titian's colour rules Venice, Palladio designs villas, Bruegel paints village life in the Low Countries and Sinan builds mosques for the Ottomans.
